title.narrative: Response for Prevention of Famine in Darfur

description.narrative:
The suffering of conflict-affected communities in West Darfur is alleviated through conflict-sensitive, integrated CVA, Agriculture and WASH assistance. Main beneficiaries are IDPs og host communities. Women, pregnant and lactating mothers are prioritized recipients through gender sensitized response.
Outcomes 1. Basic needs are met, and dignity increased amongst vulnerable households in El-Genina, Kerenik and Kulbus. 2. Increased access to nutritious food through new and restored agricultural livelihoods. 3. Vulnerable households in El Genina, Kulbus and Kerenik have improved, inclusive access to clean and safe water and improved hygiene.
